title: SEC2: fingerprint compared as colon-hex string
description: In xcid_client.rs, PinnedCertVerifier::verify_server_cert() calls cert_sha256_colon() which formats the 32-byte SHA-256 digest as a 95-character colon-separated hex string, then compares that string to self.expected_sha256 (also a 95-char string). The correct approach is to parse expected_sha256 once at construction time into [u8; 32] and compare the raw digest bytes directly (32-byte memcmp vs 95-char string compare). The current form also allocates a Vec<String> of 32 single-byte strings on every TLS handshake just to join them.
